shows.title: Kate, Allie and the '86 Mets
shows.description: Long Island, 1986. Grace and Dorothy, two recently divorced moms, each with two young kids, inspired by the HIT sitcom "Kate and Allie", move in together as best friends to solve the many challenges of single motherhood. Throughout the following decades, they build a loving, strong partnership and family. Told through the perspective of their eldest daughter, producer and writer Kate Barry, this is their story. A nostalgic, funny, heartfelt, and cinematic journey of adventures, joys, trials, and triumphs. Asking all along the way if her moms were, in fact, "Just Like Kate and Allie"? Was their union more than just a solution to single motherhood, or was it true love all along?

shows.title: Disney's Pirates of the Caribbean: The Immersive Adventure
shows.description: Trade in your seat for a place on deck in Disney’s Pirates of the Caribbean: The Immersive Adventure, presented by Secret Cinema — a live voyage through Tortuga, the Black Pearl, and the world of Captain Jack Sparrow.
